string.text: Hey, you better hide your piece, stalker. Or I'll put you down.
May my eyes pop out! And who do we have here?
Oh, holy crap, what do I do? If I go - I'll lose money. If I don't - I'll die for nothing.
Put the gun away! Now!
Hey, what are you doing here? Get lost while your legs are still intact!
They said jump, you fucking do it. Maybe you've got something else in your pockets?
One more step - and he's dead!
Let's work!
I'll cover you.
Moving out.
In position.
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
We'll meet near the station.
I don't give a damn! I think we should sell this artifact. With that money we hire people and attack the bandits.
You think they won't shoot him? Right after they get the artifact.
Damn, you can't always give in to them! No matter how much you give them - it's never enough!
I'm telling you, it's better to bring it as a ransom.
Not necessarily! If shooting starts, they'll definitely shoot him.
Alright, calm down, no one's giving in. It's just that right now the only real option is to meet their demands.
I don't trust you somehow.
Run! We need to lose them!
Now that's a thank you! You pulled me out.
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
Weapon behind your back! This is neutral territory.
We're already between two fires, pal. Put the weapon away, don't provoke.
Mark my words: you won't get into the station with a weapon.
Not so fast, pal. Put the weapon down, put it down.
You want to enter, stalker? No problem. Just hide the weapon.
Weapons are only for the fresh air.
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
Until we meet again, stalker.
That's all. You may go.
Hello, stalker.
What's your business?
Well, fair winds!
Easy travels!
Ah, hello, man.
Come in, man. Rest from the road.
Come by sometime, it gets fun around here.
Catch ya later!
Come on over, bro. I've got everything, like in Greece.
Aloha!
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
Take care. Don't get sick.
Stay healthy.
You look pale. Want me to give you a shot?
Honestly, you're like children. Another hole?
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
So, after sealing, the overpass was filled with gas.
This is the entrance to the overpass. If we start the generator, we can open the transport lock.
Schematic of the "Pripyat-1" overpass. Here's the proof - an underground route to Pripyat exists.
No, well this...
B-r-r... Are you crazy?
Well, I... Here...
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
What brings you here? I'm listening.
So here's the deal: we go together. Find some fighters, send them to me, I'll turn them into a team. When everything's ready, let me know. We pick up Nitro and head to Jupiter.
A quiet place, if you don't ask the locals questions.
It's calm here. Like at a resort.
We're almost there.
Come here quickly. The interesting part is about to start.
Well? What are you dawdling for? You'll miss everything.
Where are you? Come on, move it, something's about to happen here.
There you go! Well, I see your tongue is itching with questions? It's understandable, why not talk.
Ha-ha, look at that, you guessed it. Good, the zombies will cover us. Now waste the bastards!
Look at that, ha-ha, you guessed it. Now waste the bastards!
Now we'll see. Whether I was right or not.
Why did you have to do that? Was he bothering you? Some tough guy.
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
Ah-ah-ah, mom... What the... What? Yeah... I... I... Again.
Ugh... Imposs... Impossible. Ah, bitches, my head, oh-oh. My head is splitting.
We'll wait for you here. If something happens - we'll cover you.
Oh, holy crap. Alright, we need to get out of here, and fast.
Ah, so you're the specialist on holes? Ha! Alright, alright, don't worry, the guys are all capable, reliable, they'll deal with mutants quickly.
M-m, so... Seems calm. We can go.
It's alright. Just a few fleshes. Already dealt with.
Seems like the last one.
Oh you... He... He's inside... Inside me.
Go, we'll cover the entrance.
Opa! A zombie!
A con... con... Controller. Be ca-areful.
Greetings from Sultan, you pathetic loser!
Alright, get out of here. Entry is for Duty only.
Gavrilenko, listen up: I found out about the warehouse. It's Freedomers, a lot of them. So take the whole squad, we'll smoke those bastards out.
If the information is confirmed - you'll get access to the warehouse.
Hey, Freedom, goddammit! The warehouse is Duty territory. So get lost while you're still intact.
Well, freaks, you asked for it. Soldiers, begin the operation.
Go wander somewhere else, this area is closed.
Flint, take your people and move to Gayduk at the warehouse. Any minute now, the Duty guys will come for their things.
Excellent! Now the guys will fight them off. So, I don't forget good deeds. You can use the stash as your own. I'll warn everyone.
Hold on, dear. We'll just fill our backpacks with ammo and then you know...
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
Alright, we're here. This is Yanov station. The only safe place in the vicinity of Jupiter. I'll leave you here. Need me - look near the bar.
So long!
Bye!
Ah, hello.
Hey there!

So this is your first time here? Hmm, I came here not long ago myself. Name's Nitro, nice to meet you. I tinker with various tech, can repair anything. Although, tools are a bit tight right now. So if you come across anything, bring it straight here. And if you need technical help, I'll be glad to see you on our, Duty's side.
Go ahead.
Everyone's ready. Open it.
Ready. Squad!?
Clear here!
I'm ready too.
Oh, I don't like any of this.
Always ready!
Ah... God damn it!
Alright, here we go!
Well, ready?
There you go! Nothing for me here.
Good luck, boys!
Well - break a leg!
Well, may there be no misfires.
Hey.
How's the hunting business?
And now let's drink to the valiant expeditionary squad of Duty! Called upon to kick the asses of society's scum.

Haven't I told you about Flint? Oh, that's an interesting character. First, he set stalker hunters up for a chimera attack. Then he left his partner to die in an anomaly, and then joined Freedom. In my opinion, that's the most logical development of events. Let's also drink to more Freedomers following his example. And those who remain - we'll finish off.
I propose a toast to the fact that even in the center of the Zone, there are people ready to serve the glorious cause of Duty. To our new squad, guys!
I would like to raise my rightful due to the fact that the scientific bunker is now reliably protected. By us, Duty soldiers. Let mutants, anarchists, and other carrion just try to come near.

Soldiers! Let's drink, without chaser, to our volunteers! These are heroic people. For the benefit of domestic and global science - they take measurements in the most dangerous places of the Zone. Honor and praise to them!
I propose a toast to the Duty soldiers who, sparing no lives, repelled the attack of those dirty junkies on one of our facilities.
Absolutely!
Oh, right.
Well said!
To us!
He already croaked! We should send you after him, so you'd think twice about dragging the Zone to the mainland piece by piece.
No one knows what happened there. You certainly weren't holding a candle.

That's the squad from Monolith? Ha-ha, what a twist! I hope you'll put bloodsuckers under your banner too, and then it'll be simple. We'll list you all together under dangerous mutants and burn you out, indiscriminately. Ha-ha.
Heh, some guards you are. Forgot how you ran from mercenaries through the whole Dark Valley a year ago?

I can imagine what results the scientists will get: air samples will be one hundred percent weed, instead of water samples - watered-down alcohol. And on the recordings - your idiotic laughter, ha-ha-ha.
Nothing, we'll get those guns back. You Freedomers have a great habit: when you meet our guys, you not only start shitting bricks, but also drop your guns.

Guys, heard the news? Duty are true to their traditions. Take Ensign Morgan, for example. Obeying the harsh necessity of maintaining appearances, he was forced to step on the throat of his own crystal-clear honest nature and sell off half a warehouse of equipment.

Fall in! Remember, the unshakable traditions of Duty were laid down by His Highness General Tachenko himself. He deceived his direct subordinates, misled the command, and bravely died in a spatial bubble. Every Dutyer should strive to follow his example.

You know, when I first saw our new squad, I asked them: maybe you want to join Duty? You're free people after all, and we respect freedom of choice. And they said: nah, there everything's by order, lots of killing required, and their eyes are empty. We've already had enough of zombies, we're done.

Heard this one? A Dutyer walks up to one of our guys guarding the bunker. And asks: Professor, which artifact is better in a fight with boars? The Twist that protects from radiation, or the Eye that heals wounds? And our guy says: The Dummy, son. To regain strength while you run to your base - you'll be less winded.
People, do you know why the scientists chose our guys to take measurements of the anomaly? They first went to Shulga and said: we need to serve science. And he replied: easy, who needs to be shot?
Folks, every day I'm more and more convinced of the necessity of Duty. Just imagine: who else would gather a whole warehouse full of guns and gear, just to donate it for the good of Freedom.
Ha-ha-ha-ha.
Ha-ha-ha-ha.
Ha-ha-ha-ha.
Ha-ha-ha-ha.
Remember instead how your valiant squad crawled on their knees before us when they begged to get into Yanov before the emission.
You see, dude, we had one. You have every first one an asshole. Protect the world from the Zone - right. Forgot to add: only after we collect the valuable artifacts first.
That's right: fanatics with fanatics. You should introduce Monolith uniforms, otherwise stalkers sometimes confuse you, take you for normal people.
Mutants, you say? And will there be enough room for you in the bunker when the mutants come? It's not the 100 Rads bar, you can't hide there.
Well, if all of your guys drink like you without chaser. I can imagine the results the scientists get from you.
Yeah, and put more guards there. Half the Zone already knows about your equipment warehouse, so expect guests.
Wait! You... You find him... Ah...

You should have seen how I scored artifacts the other day. It was something, I'm telling you. Well, you know about the Quarry, don't you? Well, there's no good stuff left there. After Flint, there's nothing to look for in the anomaly - any veteran knows that.

I'll tell you everything about bloodsuckers, break it down for you. I was recently at Zaton, those suckers were bothering everyone there. A stalker brother, poor guy, was bashing them day and night. And nothing works, zero results. So I decided to help the guys. I took a shotgun and went straight into the lair, to visit the bloodsuckers. And I threw them such an evening party for three days, oh boy! Sometimes I had to light them up two or three at once. So anyway, after my discos, the bloodsuckers at Zaton aren't thriving, they've tucked their tentacles away.

Alright, I'll tell you how to take down controllers. I recently scored a bunch of artifacts, and decided to sell them, relax my spine. On the way back, I come to my stash, and there... holy crap, a controller hanging out! And not planning to leave! What a pain in the ass out of nowhere! Controller or not, but I need to get my loot. And then I suddenly see the light: if, I think, I hide behind some iron junk, all his bullshit won't matter. And so, you know what I do? I grab a metal grating that was lying around, and slowly, covering myself with it, I start walking. And while he was trying to intimidate me, while he was trying to get to my brain, while he was wondering why I'm so unimpressionable, I got closer and emptied half a clip into his head. And he turned out to be a tenacious bastard: as soon as I tossed the grate aside, he hit my brain! But I quickly shut him up with the butt...
Ha, well you really laid it on thick, Flint.
Way to go, Flint! You're the man!
Yeah... Impressive.

Well, about the route from Zaton, you know. What, no? Well, in short, guides used to make a big detour, but I blazed a shorter path. Seriously, I just took off straight: hop, one-two, back and forth. Quickly figured out all the codes for passing through anomalies, sold the route to a guide, well, not for free, obviously. So now he guides everyone using my route.

Heard about the Oasis? Definitely heard! And I've actually been there. I was the first to figure out how to get there. So here's the thing: there, honestly, there are no mutants, no anomalies-whatsits. Everything is quiet, like at my late grandmother's dacha. And artifacts - like cucumbers, lying one on top of another, just scoop them up with a shovel. I was just there the other day, sunbathing. Take you there? Ha, that's not even funny! The Oasis, sorry, isn't made of rubber.

I've got tons of stories! For example, how I worked for the scientists. Haven't I told you? Well, I dropped by their bunker once. Got curious to see what they're doing. The professors were all shocked when they saw me. Well, they say, you're just what we need. "What for?" I ask. Turns out, they need to set up their devices around anomalies, hah! Themselves, those four-eyes, naturally don't want to go. Well, they promised me cash, all sorts of goodies. And me? No problem! As long as the goodies are good. But then I had to crawl around the area quite a bit, climb through anomalies and all that. But that's nothing, nothing for a normal stalker. The real fun started later when I had to shake the promised goodies out of the professors.
Not bad!
Yeah...
Wow!

And if anyone thinks Flint is talking through his hat, let them come up to anyone at the base and ask who Flint is. Some hunters once met me and immediately started: "Flint, help! Oh, we can't do it without you!" They wanted, you know, to take down a chimera. So I had to show them how it's done. I, as always, went straight into the lair. Put one guy at the entrance to keep watch, to signal me when the chimera returns. But he fell asleep by morning and missed the chimera. When he saw its ass, he immediately hauled ass. I had to fight it off myself. And I did, as you can see, hah!

this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
Stalker! I must warn you: entering the bunker with a weapon is strictly forbidden!
Stalker, you must hide your weapon at the entrance to the research complex.
Hey, hide your weapon!
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
...find a way out... Requesting help... Supplies almost...
...no more... Second day without water, requesting help! Repeat: requesting help! Sa...
...Urgently need help! We'll last at most three more...
You came here in vain, stalker! Now you're dead!
Fall in!
Line up in a single line!
Soldiers, congratulations on joining the ranks of Duty! Follow my command: follow me, march step!
There... You can do it when you want. Well, we'll administer the oath.
Do you swear to serve the cause of Duty faithfully and truly!? To protect humanity from the aggression of the Zone and always follow the regulations!
Well? Any more questions?
Well, what are you standing for? Sit down, let's talk.
We have no strict hierarchy. We go on missions only with those we respect. But during an operation, we follow the senior's orders without question.

We respect the freedom of our soldiers and other stalkers. We believe that the Zone is open to everyone, and it is the greatest gift to humanity. A chance to significantly advance in development. This must be clearly understood by everyone.
Well, welcome to Freedom.
Who will we answer to?
Hey, stalker. Come here, please.
No matter how long you sit, you won't get anywhere.
Nothing but mutants around.
But where to go?
First we need to figure out where we are.
We need to find people.
No matter how you look at it - we're finished.
You'd better talk to Vagabond.
You probably need to go to Vagabond.
Not bad.
We swear.
Excellent. Just what I need.
We swear.
Until we meet again!
Come again!
Hello, I'm always glad to see a new person in our bunker.
Hello, hello.
Good luck to you.
Bye.
Hello.
Hi.
I won't hold you up.
M-m, is that everything? Then take care.
Ah, come here. What do you have?
Yes, yes, I'm listening.
Guys, we do everything quickly. The sooner we finish, the safer we'll be.
Alpha, beta, and gamma radiation levels measured.
Measuring now.
Torsion field scanning complete.
A little more, almost done with the torsion field measurement.
Alright, that's all the work here. Time to get out, even to hell, but get out.
God damn it, are you covering me or what?
Come on, cover us!
Hey, where did you go?
Hey, they're here! Help!
God damn it! Where are you?
They're coming! Man, what the hell?
Electromagnetic field scanning complete.
Scanning electromagnetic field.
Acoustic data for all ranges received.
Acoustic data recorded for two ranges.

Two bodies. Looks like they died upon impact. Nothing valuable: everything was looted, information on the onboard computer was deleted, but the black box survived. I think a decent technician can extract information from it.
